title: Highly stable water-based dispersion of multilayer graphene modified with sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and polyacrylate terpolymer binder
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44517-44525
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07498C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Minghua Li, Peng Wu, Honglin Chen, He Chu, Caicheng Liu
A facile and low-cost π–π surface modification of multilayer graphene was carried out by using frequently-used modifiers in LIBs and ball milling simultaneously, resulting in the formation of a highly stable dispersion reported firstly in water.
